title: Vector-bundle purity
statement:
In the finite-coefficient part of the current purity conventions ([def-pur-conventions] fixed setting), put $\Lambda=A_{E,n}$ with $n\geq1$. The integral, rational and algebraically closed versions are the separate coefficient transports of the blueprint transport section. In the ordinary-etale realization of the finite constructible category,
let $\pi:E\to B$ be a vector bundle of constant rank $r$ with zero
section $z$ [def-asd-vector-bundle-zero-section]. For every $K\in D^b_{ctf}(B,\Lambda)$ there is a
canonical isomorphism

$$
R\pi^!K\;\xrightarrow{\ \sim\ }\;L\pi^*K(r)[2r],
$$

compatible with base change, with direct sums of vector bundles, and
with the adjunctions; in particular

$$
\omega_\pi=R\pi^!\Lambda_B\;\cong\;\Lambda_E(r)[2r],
$$

and the identification is compatible with the finite reduction of the
coefficients.

Write gamma_{pi,K}=alpha_{pi,K}^{-1} for the adjoint of the actual integration trace after inverse projection. Every compatibility below concerns this same independently integration-normalized family.

For an arbitrary base change g:B'→B and its pullback bundle pi':E'→B', let e:g'^*Rpi^!→Rpi'^!g^* be the exceptional exchange (the mate of the inverse compact-support exchange) and a the tensor/pullback/Tate associator [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-topoi-derived-tensor-pullback]. On K in D^b_ctf(B,A), e is invertible and g'^*(gamma_{pi,K}) ≫ e_K = a_K ≫ gamma_{pi',g^*K}.

For F⊕G of ranks r,s use the canonical projections q:E(F⊕G)→E(G), j:E(F⊕G)→E(F), p:E(G)→B, and h=pq. Let c:R h^!≈R q^!R p^! be the right-adjoint mate of the compact-support compositor formed through an actual compactification triangle. With gamma_q obtained by base change of the first bundle's unit orientation and the dualizing tensor map, gamma_h equals a_{r,s} ≫ (1 tensor q^*gamma_p) ≫ gamma_q ≫ c^{-1}, the ordered composite.

For each 1≤m≤n use the quotient A_{E,n}→A_{E,m} and its derived scalar tensor Q [lem-pur-derived-change-of-rings]. Form q_scalar:Q_B Rpi_{!,n}≈Rpi_{!,m}Q_E from the canonical open-extension/proper-direct-image coefficient comparison [lem-pur-etale-compact-scalar-coherence]. Let b_{n,m} be the exceptional adjoint of q_scalar^{-1} ≫ Q_B(epsilon_n). Let a_scalar be the scalar tensor/pullback/Tate comparison, whose ordinary line comparison sends a tensor z to phi(a) tensor z. Then Q_E(gamma_{pi,K}) ≫ b_{n,m,K} = a_scalar,K ≫ gamma_{pi,Q_B K}, with both vertical maps invertible, including the component K=the coefficient-unit OBJECT.

All maps above use the actual integration [def-amb-vector-integration], the Tate twists [def-coefficient-twists-detailed], and the adjunction-mate convention [def-weil-pbc-adjunction-mate]. The coefficient sheaves in the current conventions are pulled-back condensed rings; at these finite levels they are constant discrete sheaves.

proof.text: Use the finite part of the current conventions: $A=A_{E,n}$ is discrete, $\ell^nA=0$, and $\ell$ is invertible on $B$. The base is Noetherian and the bundle has the compactification specified by integration. Put $W=A_E(r)[2r]$. Ordinary vector-bundle purity gives the invertible transpose $\gamma_K$ of $(1\otimes t_\pi)P_K^{-1}$; set $\alpha_K=\gamma_K^{-1}$.

source.place: paragraph 1: finite ordinary-etale integration and actual adjoint comparison

proof.text: Choose a bounded constructible etale witness for $K$; Tor comparison gives its finite Tor amplitude. Pullback and tensor comparison identify its source. The compactification has finite dimension. The bounded adjoint comparison and fully faithful site comparison identify the actual counits and their transposes, hence transport $\gamma$ to the stated etale-origin category. No unbounded pro-etale adjunction is used.

source.place: paragraph 1: finite ordinary-etale integration and actual adjoint comparison

proof.text: The geometric trace-descent lemma gives $g^*t_\pi=t_{\pi\prime}R\pi\prime_!(l)C_W$. Projection/exchange coherence tensors this equality with $g^*K$. Taking its adjoint transpose gives $e_Kg\prime^*\gamma_K=\gamma_{\pi\prime,g^*K}a_K$. Both gamma maps and $a_K$ are invertible, hence so is $e_K$. Inverting gamma gives the claimed base-change law.

source.place: paragraph 2: base change, equalities of traces, then transposition

proof.text: For $h=pq$, geometric trace descent gives the ordered two-block trace identity and permutation invariance. Compactification projection coherence and the composite tensor-transpose lemma identify its transpose with $c^{-1}\gamma_{q,Rp^!K}q^*(\gamma_{p,K})(r)[2r]$. Here $\gamma_{q,L}=\tau^q_L(1\otimes\gamma_{q,A})$ by transposing both sides. Twist additivity supplies the source associator; $(-1)^{2r\,2s}=1$.

source.place: paragraph 2: simultaneous frames, iterated counit and additive twists

proof.text: For $A_{E,n}\to A_{E,m}$ choose the common annihilator $\ell^n$. The affine scalar-counit identity at $K=A$ gives the trace equation on every trivializing open. Compact-support scalar coherence permits these restrictions. Both global sources are locally $A_{E,m}[0]$, so degree-zero gluing yields $t_m R\pi_{!,m}(l)q_W=u_BQ_B(t_n)$. The line comparison is $(z\otimes a)\otimes b\mapsto z\otimes\phi(a)b$.

source.place: paragraph 2: coefficient reduction of ordered affine traces and degree-zero descent

proof.text: Scalar projection coherence tensors this trace equation with $Q_BK$. The adjunction mate of $q^{-1}$ therefore satisfies $b_KQ_E(\gamma_{n,K})=\gamma_{m,Q_BK}a_K$. This proves its invertibility, including $K=A_B$. Finite scalar preservation gives bounded constructibility; tensor associativity preserves the Tor interval. Paste the proper scalar-mate/site equality with the open tensor square to transport this counit equation.

The definition of gamma gives $\epsilon_0=\epsilon R\pi_!(\gamma)$ and $\eta_0=\gamma^{-1}_{R\pi_!(-)}\eta$; substitution and naturality give both triangles. At $K=A_B$ obtain the dualizing formula. The affine adjunction and its trace use the identity for rank zero; empty bases give unique maps.

source.place: paragraphs 1--2: compatibility with adjunctions and the coefficient unit

proof_origin.place: Both current-blueprint paragraphs; finite ordinary-etale construction, trace identities, degree-zero descent, and adjunction transposes.

reviewed.note: mechanical checks by tools/merge_delivery.py; mathematics reviewed in full by NT-cc-O4-f57e6eb53 (reviewer sub-agent of L); spot-checked: I read the whole item, its base version, all 37 nodes it cites and the current blueprint corollary with both proof paragraphs. Steps 1–2 follow paragraph 1. Step 1 uses thm-amb-vector-bundle-purity for γ with every K. Step 2 uses the bounded-below transpose through thm-sf-ambient-adjoint-class, lem-pur-bounded-site-adjunction-transpose and site comparison; f^×K is in D⁺ by Step 1. Steps 3–7 follow paragraph 2. Step 3 (base change): I recomputed both adjoint transposes using geometric descent eq. 1 and the compact projection exchange. Step 4 (direct sum): geometric descent eq. 2, projection/compositor coherence and the composite tensor transpose; γ_{q,L}=τ(1⊗γ_{q,A}) checked; sign (−1)^{4rs}=1. Step 5: lem-sp-affine-counit-scalar is applied at K=A on affine trivializing opens, its β_d equals q_f of lem-pur-etale-compact-scalar-coherence, and degree-zero gluing gives the global equation. Step 6: projection square plus mate transpose; b is invertible by solving the equation. Step 7: elementary. Edge cases checked: r=0, either direct-sum rank zero, empty base, g=id, m=n, nonflat Z/ℓ²→Z/ℓ, ramified E. No SGA and no legacy coefficient model; the dropped statement deps (finite-reduction/scalar-single → def-weil-pbc-witness-compatibility, an adic datum) are the withdrawn route. The base proof's four helpers only restated the item's clauses (D1), so the seven-step assembly is better. 0 new nodes, no cycle, proof_deps equals the union of the step uses. Batch-5 list: def-trf-ringed-derived-open-hom-restriction and def-trf-coordinate-counit-arrows are general definitions; lem-trf-valuation-ring-specialization-lift is a general valuation-ring lift used inside proper base change; lem-pod-derived-exact-square-composition is pure homological algebra. None of these is a step of the trace formula or of Poincaré duality, so no assumption leaf is needed. I accept the 20 declared tool uses. FIX (B3): after the definition nodes were removed, q_scalar and the tensor/pullback associators had no cited node. I added [lem-pur-etale-compact-scalar-coherence] and [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-topoi-derived-tensor-pullback] to the statement and stmt_deps, and changed the dangling 'Step-5 composite' to 'composite'. No mathematical change. Advisories: (1) lem-sp-et-proet-coefficient-compatibility still lists def-weil-pbc-witness-compatibility in its stmt_deps. That is the same leftover the report gave as its reason for avoiding lem-pur-vector-trace-scalar-descent, yet lem-sp-affine-counit-scalar (cited in Step 5) depends on it. The map actually used is finite-level, so this does not break the route. (2) Step 6's pro-étale transport is not needed for the étale claim, and the open tensor square it uses is stated only A-linearly.; 1 file(s) fixed by the reviewer

The saved packet also encoded unconstrained base-change maps, a false all-small-categories compositor predicate (refuted by a nontrivial endomorphism in the one-object Z/2 category), and ring-level rather than derived reduction. Specify finite Lambda=A_{E,n}, the ordinary-etale realization, and the three actual normalized source equations, including the coefficient-unit object.
